robot.name: MagicLab MagicBot Gen1
robot.status_notes: MagicLab product page positions Gen1 for flexible manufacturing, intelligent guidance and service deployment. Secondary sources report December 2024 factory footage at an unnamed electronics factory with human oversight, and Robots International claims factory deployment since Dec 2024. No named customer or public price from MagicLab was found.

height.notes: Official product page dimensions table lists 174 cm height; source 3 converts to 1740 mm.

weight.notes: Official product page says approximately 70 kg. Source 3 also lists Total Weight Approximately 70kg but its Key Specifications incorrectly shows Net weight 40 kg; source 4 says weight not disclosed.

payload.original_value: Max Load (Both Arms): 15kg; up to 7.5 kg single-arm
payload.notes: Official product page table says Max Load (Both Arms) 15kg and body text says up to 7.5 kg single-arm load. Third-party source 2 table claims 20 kg per arm / 40 kg total, which conflicts and is excluded.

runtime.notes: Official range; source 3 says 3-5 hours, source 7 says ~4-5 hours.

battery.notes: Official product page table; source 3 lists 25 Ah (1.35 kWh).

walking_speed.notes: Official product page table lists ≥2m/s; source 3 lists ≥4 km/h equivalent.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Official page says 42-active-DoF body; source 3 breaks down neck 2, arm 7 each, waist 2, leg 6 each, optional hand 11.

hands.description: Optional 11-DoF tactile dexterous hand; source 3 says 11 DoF (6 active, 5 passive). Source 2 claims standard configuration uses 6 mini high-torque servo actuators with pressure sensors and enables sub-millimeter precision and 70% coverage of human hand gestures (company claim).

sensors.notes: Official page lists 3D LiDAR, Depth Camera, Triple Camera; source 3 says Depth Cameras ×2 + Fisheye Cameras ×3.

compute.description: 8-core CPU + 100 TOPS AI processor; Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, optional 5G.

actuators.description: In-house joint modules, maximum joint torque ≥350 N·m per joint, harmonic/planetary reducers; fully electric high-torque servos per source 2.

availability.notes: MagicLab uses contact sales; no public price from official source. Third-party resellers list conflicting prices: Robots International $119,800, AIFITLAB $218,000, Robofy $120K.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: Official product page lists an optional 11-DoF tactile dexterous hand and up to 7.5 kg single-arm load. Robozaps describes December 2024 factory footage showing precision assembly with dexterous hands and sub-millimeter precision, but this is a third-party description of a company-released video.
caveats: No independent dexterity benchmark or success rates.
Sub-millimeter precision is a company claim reported by Robozaps, not independently verified.
Hands are optional; base configuration may differ.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: MagicLab claims autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, voice interaction, face recognition, OTA and secondary development. Robozaps reports MagicLab researcher Albert Wei says factory robots were still in skill training and learning phase, not fully autonomous, with human oversight.
caveats: No independent autonomy test, intervention rate or success rate found.
Current factory deployment appears supervised.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Official product page says motion speed ≥2 m/s, max slope climbing ≥20°, stable straight-knee walking and full-body coordination, with a referenced motion video. No independent mobility benchmark or fall-rate data found.
caveats: Video not directly reviewed in this pack; only official text description used.
Speed is a company spec; not independently measured.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: Official page lists 3D LiDAR, depth and fisheye vision, face recognition, autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. Robozaps reports factory footage included visual inspection and barcode scanning with real-time location tracking.
caveats: No third-party perception benchmark.
Factory footage described by media, not directly audited.

human_interaction.summary: MagicLab lists voice interaction, voice commands, chatbot and intelligent voice guidance, omnidirectional microphone and speaker, and face recognition. No conversational reliability or instruction-following metric found.
caveats: No demonstrated conversational ability in reviewed sources.

endurance_reliability.summary: Official runtime is 3-5 hours with 25 Ah battery. Robots International claims Gen1 has been deployed on electronics-manufacturing lines since December 2024, but no uptime, failure rate or maintenance data were found.
caveats: No independent endurance test or uptime logs.
IP66 and 8.7 kN impact ratings from Robozaps are not confirmed by MagicLab and are excluded from official specs.

human_environment_fit.summary: Gen1 is 174 cm tall, about 70 kg, with a humanoid footprint 174×58×28 cm and supported terrains described as 'All Terrains' by source 1/3. No safety certification or human-proximity safety study found.
caveats: No full-robot safety certification found.
A 70 kg moving robot may pose safety risks; no human-proximity safety disclosures found.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Robozaps describes a December 2024 company-released video of multiple Gen1 robots collaborating at an unnamed electronics factory. Robots International claims Gen1 has been deployed on electronics-manufacturing lines since December 2024. The Mimic's evidence ledger found zero linked customer deployment records.
caveats: Factory is unnamed; no customer confirmation.
MagicLab researcher says robots were in skill training phase, not fully autonomous.
No commercial metrics.

accessibility_value.summary: MagicLab uses contact sales with no public price. Third-party resellers list conflicting prices: Robots International $119,800, AIFITLAB $218,000, Robofy $120K. Official SDK and secondary development support lower barriers for researchers, but there is no public purchase path from MagicLab.
caveats: No official price or direct online purchase from MagicLab.
Reseller prices conflict and may not reflect final sold prices.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: MagicBot Gen1 has credible official specs and a company-released December 2024 factory deployment video, but all deployment evidence is unnamed and autonomy is acknowledged by MagicLab as still in training with human oversight. No public price or customer metrics were found.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official product page with full-size biped specs, 42 DoF, 7.5 kg single-arm load, 3-5 h runtime.
Robozaps report of December 2024 multi-robot factory footage with inspection, assembly and scanning.
Robots International claim of Gen1 deployed on electronics-manufacturing lines since Dec 2024.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No named customer or independent verification of deployment.
No output metrics, uptime, failure rates or autonomy logs.
No official price; third-party reseller prices conflict.
conflicting_claims: Payload: official 7.5 kg single-arm / 15 kg both arms vs Robozaps table 20 kg per arm / 40 kg total.
Weight: source 3 key spec says Net weight 40 kg while All Specifications says Total Weight Approximately 70kg; official says approx 70 kg.
IP66 rating listed by Robozaps but not in official product page.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit Z1 specs or Spring Festival Gala performance to Gen1.
Do not claim a named customer deployment.
Do not treat factory footage as evidence of full autonomy.
Do not use third-party payload 20 kg per arm as official.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: MagicBot Gen1 is MagicLab's full-size electric humanoid (174 cm, approx 70 kg, 42 active DoF) with optional 11-DoF tactile hands, 3D LiDAR, depth and fisheye vision, and an 8-core CPU + 100 TOPS AI processor. MagicLab lists contact sales and 3-5 hours runtime with 7.5 kg single-arm load. Secondary sources report MagicLab released December 2024 footage of multiple Gen1 robots doing inspection, material handling, assembly and barcode scanning at an unnamed electronics factory, with a researcher saying the robots were still in skill training with human oversight. No named customer or output metrics were found, and third-party resale prices conflict ($119,800-$218,000).
strongest_evidence: Official product page confirms full-size biped specs and autonomous feature claims.
Robozaps describes December 2024 factory footage of multiple Gen1 robots collaborating.
Robots International states Gen1 has been deployed on electronics-manufacturing lines since December 2024.
weakest_evidence: No named customer deployment or output metrics.
No independent autonomy verification; MagicLab says training phase with human oversight.
Conflicting third-party payload and price data; no official price.
known_do_not_credit: Do not credit Z1 specs or Gala performance to Gen1.
Do not use 20 kg per arm / 40 kg total payload from Robozaps table.
Do not use IP66 rating as official Gen1 spec.
Do not treat JD.com sellout as Gen1 sales.
